No, as a Leafy Plus member you don't pay the $6.95 fee. Change-of-mind returns are free for members.

A planter counts as a non-living item, so it's eligible if you return it within **30 days** of delivery, unused and in its original packaging. Start the return from "My Orders" and a prepaid label will be emailed to you. Drop the parcel off within **7 days**, because the label expires after that. Your refund will be issued to your original payment method within **5 business days** of the return reaching our warehouse.
